name: GPT Image 2 Tool
description: Generate and edit images using OpenAI GPT Image 2 model

description_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 OpenAI GPT Image 2 模型生成与编辑图像
description_i18n.en-US: Generate and edit images using OpenAI GPT Image 2 model

author: QwenPaw Team

tools.name: generate_image_gpt
tools.description: Generate high-quality images from text prompts using GPT Image 2

config_fields.name: api_key
config_fields.label: OpenAI API Key
config_fields.help: Get your API key from platform.openai.com

config_fields.name: endpoint
config_fields.label: API Endpoint
config_fields.help: Custom API endpoint (leave empty to use default /images/generations)

tools.name: edit_image_gpt
tools.description: Edit or generate images using reference images with GPT Image 2

config_fields.name: api_key
config_fields.label: OpenAI API Key
config_fields.help: Get your API key from platform.openai.com

config_fields.name: endpoint
config_fields.label: API Endpoint
config_fields.help: Custom API endpoint (leave empty to use default /images/edits)

tools.name: generate_image_gpt_eval
tools.description: Generate images via Aliyun DashScope's eval cluster brokering OpenAI GPT Image 2 (azure.gpt-image-2). Uses DashScope key; caller IP must be whitelisted.

config_fields.name: api_key
config_fields.label: DashScope API Key
config_fields.help: DashScope key with eval-cluster access. Different from the OpenAI key used by generate_image_gpt.

config_fields.name: timeout
config_fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
config_fields.help: HTTP request timeout in seconds (default: 480 to match the OpenAI-direct tool)

tools.name: edit_image_gpt_eval
tools.description: Edit/compose images with multi-reference input via Aliyun DashScope's eval cluster brokering OpenAI GPT Image 2.

meta.api_key_hint: generate_image_gpt / edit_image_gpt use the OpenAI key. generate_image_gpt_eval / edit_image_gpt_eval use a DashScope key with eval-cluster access (separate config).
